# ParkSafe

> ParkSafe is a free urban cycling navigation and parking application for iOS and Android. It helps cyclists across Central Europe plan safety-first routes, find bicycle parking and repair services, and make decisions using community-maintained location data.

ParkSafe combines more than 7,500 bicycle parking locations, more than 800 service points, community ratings and photos, and daily updated ride-impact data in one platform. Core functionality is currently free, with no paid service tier.

## Product and Features

- [ParkSafe Features](https://parksafe.hu/#platform): Overview of safety-first cycle routing, bicycle parking, service locations, live urban data, and community validation.
- [How ParkSafe Works](https://parksafe.hu/#how-it-works): Four-step guide covering download, city discovery, community validation, and navigation to a selected parking location.
- [Pricing and Product FAQ](https://parksafe.hu/#faq): Answers about free access, coverage, route planning, parking-location details, and data reliability.
- [Community Impact](https://parksafe.hu/#impact): Daily updated aggregate ride, distance, and estimated CO2-savings figures with the calculation methodology shown on the page.
